rule: Within one contiguous segment: prior close < prior lower Bollinger Band AND current close >= current lower Bollinger Band. Bands use 20 completed 1h closes, SMA +/- 2 population standard deviations (ddof=0). Each re-entry is one event. No other filters.
hypothesis: Recovery inside the lower band after a downside excursion may mark temporary selling exhaustion and positive subsequent long-only returns. Unproven; no claim of causal mechanism.
costs: Reuse frozen standard, conditional BNB and stress assumptions; standard primary.
baseline: Unconditional completed 1h decisions with identical 5m execution and holding period.
multiplicity: Append exactly one primary comparison as test 35 if evaluated. Preserve every prior p-value; BY correction across 35 tests.
adaptive_disclosure: Prior rounds and their results were seen. This is adaptive exploratory research on reused development history, not fresh validation.
workflow: Commit registration; calculate feature-only counts; if all feasibility gates pass, evaluate one fixed primary outcome and unchanged gates. If feasibility fails, stop without testing returns. No grid, alternate exit or automatic additional round.
selection: No automatic strategy promotion or trading. Stop after this registered round for review.
